name: syncpath
description: SyncPath — AI product team workspace (monorepo root)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "VITE_HOST=0.0.0.0 VITE_STRICT_PORT=true VITE_PORT=${VITE_PORT:-5183} VITE_API_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:${API_PORT:-3160} npm run dev -w apps/web" "API_HOST=0.0.0.0 API_PORT=${API_PORT:-3160} COOKIE_SECURE=false npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.preview:lan: npm run build && npm run preview -w apps/web -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${VITE_PORT:-5184} --strictPort
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/domain && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/domain && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w packages/domain && npm run prisma:generate -w apps/api
